items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: How did you like playing with Kenny Clarke at that time? ... It was a good sound, yeah, and he -- of course, at times, he played off tempos and what have you quite a bit. But I didn't -- that didn't bother me. I became used to that.

ctx.x: -- and I think Miles Davis had a band with Tadd Dameron and Kenny Clarke.
That's right, yes, come to think of it.
